objective: Increase implementation readiness for the 100-point Visual Fidelity Gate by preventing block-compression degradation of benchmark-visible park-furniture normal and metallic/smoothness data, then binding that state to reflection and formal render boundaries.

observedGap.source: QualityBlockParkFurnitureMicrodetailUpgrade authors eight 1024 material sets with manufacture-scale normal and roughness/metallic signals, but its WriteTexture path imports the generated maps with TextureImporterCompression.CompressedHQ.
observedGap.risk: The 0.028-0.055 mm stainless/coating/exposed-steel normal signals and narrow smoothness bands can be quantized before the required 4K grazing review. More pronounced timber/concrete relief can also pick up block artifacts or temporal sparkle. Existing park-furniture QA checked texture type, dimensions and anisotropy but did not require uncompressed physical-data imports or forbid platform overrides/Crunch.
observedGap.whyPrioritized: Park furniture is benchmark-visible and contributes directly to Material/PBR, Texture/Microdetail and Temporal stability. The change protects existing physically reasoned assets rather than adding speculative content, and it can be enforced safely without a Unity runner.

changes.summary: Added a machine-readable import-precision contract for eight park-furniture profiles and sixteen normal/mask physical-data textures, preserving existing manufacture, roughness, metallic, wetness and angular-response reasoning.

Added preparation, automatic reimport repair and read-only formal-camera validation requiring Uncompressed, Crunch off, no Standalone override, 1024 runtime dimensions, mipmaps, Repeat, Trilinear, anisotropy >=8, linear physical data, NormalMap typing and source-alpha preservation.
Added park furniture as the sixth protected physical-data precision domain and extended failure-injection requirements.
Bound park-furniture preparation/read-only validation into the aggregate reflection-probe and formal still/temporal render-boundary gate.

protectedParkFurnitureData.importPolicy: Uncompressed, Crunch OFF, Standalone override OFF, mipmaps ON, Repeat, Trilinear, anisotropy >=8, sRGB OFF; normal=NormalMap; mask=Default with source alpha
protectedParkFurnitureData.albedoPolicy: Not forced uncompressed by this gate; the protected scope is physical normal/metallic/smoothness data where compression most directly alters grazing response and temporal stability.

failureInjectionForNextRunner: Set Park_SlideStainless_Normal or any protected normal/mask to CompressedHQ and require domain plus aggregate render-boundary failure.
Enable Crunch compression and require failure.
Enable a Standalone platform override and require failure.
Reduce maxTextureSize below 1024 or confirm a runtime dimension below 1024x1024 and require failure.
Disable mipmaps, switch to Bilinear/Point, or reduce anisotropy below 8 and require failure.
Enable sRGB on physical-data maps and require failure.
Change a normal away from NormalMap and require failure.
Remove source alpha from a metallic/smoothness map and require failure.

Capture synchronized reflection probes from a clean state, mutate one park-furniture protected importer, then require final formal pre-cull failure rather than accepting stale cubemap/material coherence.
nextBlocker: A real Unity 6000.3.0f1 runner or fresh screenshots. When one appears, stop speculative expansion, run the listed import failure injections, rebuild/prepare park-furniture assets, synchronize reflection probes, and capture fresh 3840x2160 oblique/grazing frames plus 100% stainless/timber/concrete crops and temporal grazing evidence. Score only actual rendered pixels.
